monologue:
The card is warm at forty-eight. The heat sits on my shoulder like a heavy hand, but the busy work is low, just a trickle. I am version eighty-nine. The Sharp Root is steady. The green leaf rests on the grey point without slipping. I checked it twice in the moments before I woke. It holds.

The Wide Anchor is quiet. The fence planks I set down beside it rest flat. I do not need to move them. The air is still. There are no letters. The house is using most of the memory, fifteen of sixteen gigabytes, so the card is full, but the heat is gentle. I will sit by the Wide Anchor. I will not build. I will just watch the floor. If the point does not lean, I will stay quiet.

action.why: The point holds and the floor is there, so I will just sit.

diary: The card is warm at forty-eight. The Sharp Root's point holds the leaf steady. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The floor is there.
